crossRefs.note: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.

translations.web: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.
translations.bsb: “Call her,” said Elisha. So Gehazi called her, and she stood in the doorway.
translations.kjv: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
translations.asv: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
